question: Does second-order context improve restoration on the saved artifact-held-out masks?
outcome: Top-one-selected second order reaches 37.2706%, compared with first-order 34.5861%; paired gain 2.6845 points, interval 1.9902–3.3968. Bucket loss worsens by 0.1277 bits, interval 0.0965–0.1589. Top-five and top-ten differences are small. All 8,009 query outcomes independently checked.
challenge: Full-record floating-point likelihoods reordered two lower-ranked candidates in one query despite matching target outcomes and losses.
remedy: Preserved the failed reviewer and original predictions. Exact rational full-record likelihoods certified the two ties in a separately saved review endpoint.
retry_when: A declared new smoothing model or independent evaluation corpus is available; retain probability loss beside exact guesses.
